proposals.title: Gender Pay Gap report
proposals.topic_summary: Prepare a report by October 2017 on the company's policies and goals to reduce the gender pay gap.
proposals.evidence: the Board recommends that you vote AGAINST this Proposal 5.

proposals.title: Stockholder Value Committee
proposals.topic_summary: Form an independent committee to evaluate whether divesting all non-core banking segments would enhance shareholder value and publicly report its analysis.
proposals.evidence: the Board recommends that you vote AGAINST Proposal 6.

proposals.title: Lobbying disclosure report
proposals.topic_summary: Prepare an annual report disclosing direct and indirect lobbying policies, payments, and board oversight of lobbying and grassroots lobbying.
proposals.evidence: the Board recommends that you vote AGAINST this Proposal 7.

proposals.title: Clawback Amendment
proposals.topic_summary: Amend the clawback policy to defer and forfeit executive pay to help satisfy monetary penalties for legal violations, with deferral of 10 years.
proposals.evidence: the Board recommends a vote AGAINST this Proposal 8.

proposals.title: Government Service Golden Parachute
proposals.topic_summary: Adopt a policy prohibiting vesting of equity awards for senior executives who voluntarily resign to enter government service.
proposals.evidence: the Board recommends a vote AGAINST this Proposal 9.
